canonical_situation: A listed pickup is canceled or has no packages
normalized_description: The driver must distinguish a canceled pickup with no attempt from an attempted pickup at a closed location with no packages.
authoritative_rule: Use pickup reason 24 only for P/U Cancelled - No Attempt Made. Use pickup reason 11 only for Closed - Attempted, No Packages. For an attempted listed pickup with zero packages, FORGE uses Close (Zero Pkg), confirms zero packages, asks for the truthful reason code, and closes with DONE. The sources do not establish reason 11 for every on-site cancellation.
applicability: A listed pickup was canceled before any attempt
A listed pickup was attempted at a closed location and no packages were obtained
The listed pickup must be closed with zero packages
conditions: Reason 24 requires no attempt
Reason 11 requires an attempted pickup at a closed location with no packages
The selected pickup and reason must match what actually happened
exceptions: If the driver arrived but the location was not closed, the reviewed sources do not establish that reason 11 applies merely because someone canceled
Call tags and unlisted pickups are outside this record

required_procedure.action: Determine whether no attempt was made or the pickup was attempted at a closed location with no packages.
Open the correct listed pickup and choose Close (Zero Pkg).
Confirm the Stop Close Summary shows 0 packages and continue.
Select reason 24 for a canceled pickup with no attempt, or reason 11 for a closed location that was attempted with no packages.
Select DONE to close the stop.

prohibited_actions: Do not use reason 24 after an attempt
Do not use reason 11 solely because an on-site contact says canceled when the location is not closed
Do not guess a reason code to close the stop
escalation_requirements: Ask station or service-provider management when an attempted cancellation does not match the source-defined closed/no-packages condition
clarification_requirements: Was any attempt made at the pickup location?
If attempted, was the location closed and were zero packages obtained?
driver_question_variants: I went there but the pickup was closed and had nothing
concise_ready_route_answer: First determine whether you attempted the pickup. If it was canceled before any attempt, use reason 24. If you attempted it at a closed location and got no packages, use reason 11. Open the correct listed pickup, choose Close (Zero Pkg), confirm 0 packages, select the matching reason, and tap DONE. If you arrived but the location was not closed, confirm the reason with management instead of assuming code 11.
more_info_answer: This narrows the partner handoff to the exact conditions printed in MGB-119. The FORGE guide supplies the zero-package close workflow but requires the reason selected to match the real condition.

evidence.evidence_summary: Defines 24 as P/U Cancelled - No Attempt Made and 11 as Closed - Attempted, No Packages.

canonical_situation: A delivery package has no usable normal barcode or only a 00 barcode
normalized_description: The driver cannot scan the expected package barcode and must determine whether the special 00 key-entry contingency applies or the package must return for relabeling.
authoritative_rule: A package with no barcode is returned to the station for a replacement barcode. A 00 barcode should have a 2D or 96 primary barcode, which is scanned instead. If the 2D barcode cannot be scanned, the 20-digit 00 number may be entered using SHIFT + Scan. If no 2D or 96 barcode is present, return the package for a replacement barcode.

Delivery package displays a 00 barcode
conditions: Key entry of the 00 number applies when the accompanying 2D barcode is present but cannot be scanned
Use the 2D or 96 barcode instead of 00 when available and scannable

required_procedure.action: Inspect the package for a 2D or 96 primary barcode.
Scan the 2D or 96 barcode if present and usable.
If the accompanying 2D barcode cannot be scanned, use SHIFT + Scan to enter the 20-digit 00 number.
If no barcode exists, or a 00 barcode has no accompanying 2D or 96 barcode, retain the package and return it to the station for a replacement barcode.

prohibited_actions: Do not deliver a package with no barcode because proof of delivery will not transmit
Do not scan 00 instead of a usable primary 2D or 96 barcode
clarification_requirements: Is a 2D or 96 barcode present?
Did the 2D barcode fail to scan?

concise_ready_route_answer: Look for a 2D or 96 barcode first and scan that. If an accompanying 2D barcode is present but will not scan, press SHIFT + Scan and enter the 20-digit 00 number. If there is no barcode, or the 00 barcode has no accompanying 2D or 96 barcode, return the package to the station for a replacement barcode.
more_info_answer: This special 00-barcode contingency is not generic permission to invent or key-enter a number when the required label is absent.
